name: app-flow-cycling-hero-hand-touching-bike-on-phone-screen
title: Flow cycling app hero: a hand touching a bike photo on a phone screen against black and white curves
whatItIs: A cover with a black background curving into a white organic shape, a phone held by a hand with a finger touching a close-up bike photo captioned 'Daha Akıllı Sür / Daha / Uzağa Git.' with a mint 'Başla' (Start) button, and the mint 'flow' logo with a flower-like icon bottom-left.
whatItMeans: Tactile and premium; the touch gesture and organic black/white split give a fitness app a design-object feel.
techniques: Show a finger touching the screen for tactility.
Split the backdrop with an organic black-and-white curve.
Keep the logo simple and place it away from the action.

vocabulary.definition: A photo showing a finger interacting with a screen.
